The [[Followers of Palawa]] were known to have developed of a certain type of '''[[Hibernation trance/Legends|hibernation trance]]''' prior to [[24,500 BBY]] that permitted practitioners to enter into a deep trance state and sleep for decades without aging.<ref name="JvS" /> Some practitioners were recorded as having slept in excess of seventy [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] while engaged in this trance.<ref name="TCSWEI">{{CSWECite|I|284|Followers of Palawa}}</ref>

[[Arden Lyn]], a Follower of Palawa<ref name="TCSWEII">{{CSWECite|II|268|Lyn, Arden}}</ref> and [[Steel Hand of Palawa]]<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> prior to her tenure in the [[Legions of Lettow]], was aware of this technique and was theorized to have employed it in conjunction with her [[Kashi Mer talisman]]<ref name="JvS" /> to survive [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Awdrysta Pina]]'s use of [[Morichro/Legends|''morichro'']] to stop her heart.<ref name="TEP">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref>
